company.name: MinIO
company.shortDescription: MinIO delivers unmatched enterprise performance, scale, agility and economics for AI data, agentic computing, and analytics.
company.description: MinIO is a provider of High Performance Enterprise Object Storage solution released under a proprietary license. It is API compatible with Amazon S3 cloud storage service and designed for production enterprise environments. Use MinIO AIStor to build high performance infrastructure for machine learning, analytics and application data workloads with enterprise-grade features, support and compliance.

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise object data store for AI, analytics, and agentic computing, supporting S3-compatible objects, Apache Iceberg tables, and SFTP-accessible files.
productsAndServices.name: MinIO AIStor

productsAndServices.description: A context memory store for AI inference that provides shared, petabyte-scale storage for inference context and KV-cache data.
productsAndServices.name: MinIO MemKV

productsAndServices.description: An open-source, S3-compatible object storage server for structured and unstructured data, available for self-managed deployments.
productsAndServices.name: MinIO Community Edition

productsAndServices.description: A Kubernetes CSI driver and distributed persistent-volume manager for discovering, provisioning, mounting, scheduling, and monitoring direct-attached drives.
productsAndServices.name: MinIO DirectPV

productsAndServices.description: Technical and operational support for MinIO deployments, including product issue resolution, deployment assistance, and direct-to-engineering support.
productsAndServices.name: MinIO Support

productsAndServices.description: A training and certification program offering online courses, hands-on labs, webinars, instructor-led training, and MinIO administrator certification.
productsAndServices.name: MinIO Academy
